briefs: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel phase-out language.
Ukraine hits the Crimea Bridge with Ruta missiles.
Trump, Xi and Putin close Shenzhen trilateral with a four-point declaration.
Nicholls hits 113 not out as New Zealand face India.

lead.body: Cyclone Akvan made landfall at midday in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, winds to 110 km/h. Over 300,000 fled to shelters.
lead.headline: Cyclone Akvan slams India's east coast as 300,000 flee to shelter

stories.body: The International Court of Justice ruled 9 to 6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.
stories.headline: World court finds Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide

stories.body: Somalia expelled the UAE ambassador, giving him 72 hours to leave in a sharp diplomatic escalation.
stories.headline: Somalia orders UAE envoy out within 72 hours

stories.body: Russian strikes on Kyiv damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies, drawing condemnation.
stories.headline: Russian strikes damage Austrian and Dutch embassies

stories.body: The Dow fell 2.19 percent to 49,097 while the S and P lost 2.02 percent and the Nasdaq 2.25 percent.
stories.headline: Dow slides below 50,000 in sixth straight loss

stories.body: Ant shares closed their first day at $97.17, up 17 percent from the $83 offer price.
stories.headline: Ant Group closes debut up 17 percent

stories.body: Israel said buffer zones in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria will be permanent, reshaping regional security.
stories.headline: Israel declares permanent buffer zones

tagline: The world's news in one image
